title: Five other out-of-the-box roles have Settings Finance off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the out-of-the-box roles are reset to their templates.
  • Start on Settings, Roles & Permissions.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the permissions of the "Service Advisor" role.
  2. Open the permissions of the "Foreman" role.
  3. Open the permissions of the "Technician" role.
  4. Open the permissions of the "Parts Technician" role.
  5. Open the permissions of the "Time Clock User" role.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Finance" under "Settings" is off.

Step 2:

  • "Finance" under "Settings" is off.

Step 3:

  • "Finance" under "Settings" is off.

Step 4:

  • "Finance" under "Settings" is off.

Step 5:

  • "Finance" under "Settings" is off.

The PRD names "Parts Technician" and "Time Clock User"; on Roles & Permissions they may read "Parts Tech" and "Time Clock".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “By default 'Settings → Finance' is on for the Admin profile (required, cannot be turned off), Parts Manager and Office User, and off for Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Technician, Sales Representative and Time Clock User.”
